body:
Triage → `needs-user-decision` (human floor: public-contract shape). Two contract questions, one property:

**Q1 — which shape is the contract for `ListView.exportOptions`?** Today the spec publishes a bare enum array (`view.zod.ts:1438`) and the only renderer reads an object (`ObjectGrid.tsx:1394` → `.formats`), so **no declaration is both type-legal and functional**.
**Q2 — the dead `'pdf'` enum member** (feature closed NOT_PLANNED as #1301; declared-but-unrenderable today, signalled only by a runtime `console.warn`).

Premises, with re-check commands:
- Spec side: `git grep -n "exportOptions" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`
- Renderer side (objectui): `git grep -n "exportOptions" -- packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx packages/types/src/objectql.ts` (the "Aligned with @objectstack/spec" comment at `types/src/objectql.ts:785` is false today)
- PDF status: objectstack#1301 closed NOT_PLANNED

Options:
- **A** — spec adopts the object form the renderer reads (`{ formats?: [...] }` with array-form normalization for back-compat); drop `'pdf'`.
- **B** — renderer moves to the spec's bare array; the objectui object type is retired and the false comment corrected in the same change; drop `'pdf'`.
- **C** — leave both, document the divergence (recorded for completeness; keeps the trap).

Four-lens:
- **Platform long-term coherence**: B keeps one minimal contract and moves the sole consumer onto it. A imports objectui's speculative keys (`maxRecords`, `includeHeaders`, `fileNamePrefix` — no evidence the renderer reads any of them) into the spec unless trimmed to `formats` alone, at which point A is just B with an extra wrapper object.
- **Measured business pull**: real — titanwind-ehr (§7.7) needs XLSX in the export menu today; A or B both unblock it. Nothing measured pulls the three extra object keys.
- **AI-agent error-resistance**: a closed enum array is the hardest shape to get wrong; the current type-legal ≠ functional split is the worst possible state. `'pdf'` must leave the enum or become a validate-time refusal — a runtime `console.warn` is silent tolerance.
- **Startup scope discipline**: B is the narrowest change that makes declared = enforced; every extra declared key is a permanent obligation.

**Recommendation: B** — fix ObjectGrid to read the spec's array, correct the false alignment comment in the same change, and drop `'pdf'` from the spec enum as an honest narrowing. Richer export config later is a new Feature decision, not part of this repair.

Execution note once ruled: contract-first split — the spec enum narrowing lands here first (`domain:spec`, contract-changing ⇒ fable clause applies), the objectui renderer/type fix follows with `Blocked-by:` on it.

**Maintainer ruling — 2026-08-12** (live PM chat, `session_01GxKQfv3k8b6a2d2QrZU411`; maintainer sam, verbatim: 「接受你的全部建议。」 accepting the decision-box analysis in full). Moved out of the decision box → `pm:queue`.

Ruling: **option A — the spec adopts the object form** (`exportOptions: { formats?: … }`, with array-form normalization for back-compat), and **`'pdf'` leaves the enum** (honest narrowing; ⛔ not a runtime `console.warn`, which is silent tolerance).

⚠️ **This reverses the earlier triage lean toward option B, because B's stated premise is falsified on current objectui main.** The triage note read "no evidence the renderer reads any of `maxRecords`, `includeHeaders`, `fileNamePrefix`"; `ObjectGrid.tsx` (now ~:1529–1575) in fact reads **five** object keys — `formats`, `maxRecords`, `includeHeaders`, `fileNamePrefix`, and an undeclared `streaming` opt-out. Option B would therefore delete four live renderer behaviours, not adopt speculative keys.

Execution order (contract-first, unchanged): the spec change lands **here first** — `domain:spec` semantic lane, so the **`claude-fable-5` clause applies** — and the objectui renderer/type reconciliation follows with `Blocked-by:` on this card. The undeclared `streaming` key must be either declared in the same pass or removed on the objectui side; a fifth undeclared key surviving this fix would recreate the defect.

Business note for sequencing: `steedos-labs/os-project-titanwind-ehr#1161` has a contractual §7.7 export commitment blocked with **no legal-and-functional declaration available today** — this is the only decision-box card with an external customer waiting. Prioritise accordingly within the spec lane.
